article_content: Editor's note: Ralph J. Begleiter teaches communication, journalism, and political science at the University of Delaware. During two decades as CNN's 'world affairs correspondent,' he was the network's most widely traveled reporter. Ralph J. Begleiter says the Pentagon's new policy on media access to coffins of war dead is a milestone. NEWARK, Delaware (CNN) -- Reversing two decades of policy on images of returning war casualties is an important and welcome milestone for the American people. On Thursday, the Pentagon announced that media coverage of coffins of war victims returning to Dover Air Force Base will be allowed if families agree. This restores the immense value of the sacrifice American troops make and allows the American people to honor the dignified and respectful final return of war casualties. Although no one should veto the nation's ability to pay respects to its fallen troops, I believe most families will feel their loved ones deserve public recognition. These men and women enlisted for their nation, fought for their nation, and died for their nation. Their return should be respectfully and publicly acknowledged by their nation. The ban on images of returning casualties began accidentally and not because of 'privacy' concerns for families. This arose in December 1989 when a scheduling oversight placed President George H.W. Bush on live TV just as the first American casualties from the Panama invasion were arriving at Dover Air Force Base. CNN and two other major networks used split-screen technology, showing the president joking with reporters on one side and the solemn images of flag-draped caskets on the other. After the holidays, the president appealed publicly to reporters to 'help me' overcome the perception of insensitivity about these returning casualties. News media had covered the return of war casualties since World War II. Some in the military believed showing these images, including scenes from Vietnam, contributed to rising anti-war sentiment in the 1960s. Just days before the Gulf War began in January 1991, the Defense Department sent a cable formalizing the new media policy: No coverage of returning casualties at Dover or other stops along the way. This directive did not mention privacy but framed the ban as a way to reduce pressure on families who might feel compelled to travel to Dover in front of news media. Over the next decade, there were several exceptions to the Dover ban, including coverage of Navy personnel killed in the bombing of the USS Cole just weeks before the second President Bush took office. Ironically, while media coverage was banned, the Pentagon continued to document this significant aspect of war by assigning photographers to capture images of the flag-draped caskets. These dignified images were maintained by the Defense Department and used for honor guard training and to commemorate war casualties. Although taken by government photographers, these images were withheld from public view. From 9/11 through the 2003 invasion of Iraq, the Pentagon kept recording these returns while expanding the coverage ban, citing potential invasion of families' privacy. In 2005, following a series of Freedom of Information Act requests, these images were released after months of legal disputes. (Russ Kick, editor of 'The Memory Hole,' initiated the requests. When the Pentagon failed to respond to my own requests, the National Security Archive at George Washington University and I filed a lawsuit.) Weeks before a federal judge was expected to rule, the Pentagon voluntarily released more than 700 images of returning casualties. They remain publicly accessible through the National Security Archive website. When Kick and I sought to publicize those Pentagon pictures, major U.S. news organizations were focused on covering the Iraq invasion. They did not use their lawyers to demand access to Dover and have not done so since. A policy originally tied to a president's embarrassment evolved after the Iraq invasion into a complete ban that prevented Americans from seeing a crucial measure of war's cost. It appeared that the White House so strongly opposed public viewing of these images that military photographers at Dover were ordered to cease documenting the returns. To my knowledge, since 2005, no further photos have captured those emotional moments when a casualty arrives on home soil for the last time. The Obama administration's reversal of this policy should have two immediate effects: First, public opinion remains strongly in favor of releasing these images. A CNN/Opinion Research Corp. survey released Thursday found that 67 percent said the public should be allowed to see photos of caskets of U.S. troops at an Air Force base. Second, I have spoken with many families who lost loved ones in Afghanistan or Iraq. Most support making the pictures public, but only after families permit it. This policy change will once again allow Americans to see the human cost of war, while honoring those who served and their families. The opinions in this commentary are solely those of Ralph J. Begleiter.
translated_content: Urednička napomena: Ralph J. Begleiter predaje komunikaciju, novinarstvo i političke znanosti na Sveučilištu u Delawareu. Tijekom dva desetljeća kao CNN-ov 'dopisnik za svjetska pitanja', bio je najproputovaniji reporter mreže. Ralph J. Begleiter kaže da je nova politika Pentagona o medijskom pristupu lijesovima poginulih u ratu važan korak naprijed. NEWARK, Delaware (CNN) -- Preokret dvadesetogodišnje politike o prikazivanju ratnih žrtava koje se vraćaju kući važan je i dobrodošao korak za američku javnost. U četvrtak je Pentagon objavio da će medijsko praćenje lijesova ratnih žrtava koje se vraćaju u zračnu vojnu bazu Dover biti dopušteno ako se obitelji slože. Time se vraća priznanje neizmjernoj žrtvi koju američki vojnici podnose i omogućuje Amerikancima odavanje počasti dostojanstvenom, posljednjem povratku ratnih žrtava. Iako nitko ne bi trebao spriječiti naciju da oda počast palim vojnicima, vjerujem da će većina obitelji smatrati da njihovi voljeni zaslužuju javno priznanje. Ti muškarci i žene prijavili su se u vojsku za svoju naciju, borili se za nju i umrli za nju. Njihov povratak treba biti poštovan i javno priznat od strane nacije. Zabrana prikazivanja slika ratnih žrtava koje se vraćaju započela je slučajno i ne zbog 'privatnosti' obitelji. To se dogodilo u prosincu 1989., kada je loše planiran raspored doveo predsjednika Georgea H.W. Busha pred televizijske kamere baš kad su prve američke žrtve iz invazije na Panamu pristizale u bazu Dover. CNN i dvije druge velike mreže upotrijebile su tehnologiju podijeljenog ekrana, prikazujući predsjednika koji se šali s novinarima na jednoj strani i ozbiljne prizore lijesova prekrivenih zastavama na drugoj. Nakon blagdana, predsjednik je javno zamolio novinare da mu 'pomognu' prevladati dojam neosjetljivosti u vezi s tim povratkom žrtava. Mediji su pratili povratak ratnih žrtava još od Drugog svjetskog rata. Neki vojni dužnosnici vjerovali su da prikazivanje takvih slika, uključujući prizore iz Vijetnama, pridonosi rastu proturatnog raspoloženja 1960-ih. Nekoliko dana prije početka Zaljevskog rata u siječnju 1991. Ministarstvo obrane poslalo je dopis kojim se zabranjuje medijsko praćenje povratka žrtava u Dover ili drugim postajama na putu. Ta odredba nije spominjala privatnost nego je zabranu opravdala kao pokušaj smanjenja pritiska na obitelji koje bi se mogle osjećati obveznima doći u Dover pred tv-kamerama. Tijekom sljedećeg desetljeća napravljeno je nekoliko iznimaka od zabrane u Doveru, uključujući povratak mornaričkog osoblja poginulog u bombaškom napadu na USS Cole samo nekoliko tjedana prije nego što je drugi predsjednik Bush preuzeo dužnost. Ironično je da je, unatoč zabrani, Pentagon nastavio dokumentirati taj važan element rata angažirajući vojne i ugovorne fotografe da snimaju slike lijesova prekrivenih zastavama. Te dostojanstvene slike čuvane su u Ministarstvu obrane i korištene za obuku počasne straže i obilježavanje značaja ratnih žrtava. Iako su to bile vladine fotografije, država ih je uskraćivala javnosti. Od napada 11. rujna do invazije na Irak u ožujku 2003., Pentagon je nastavio fotografirati te povratke dok je širio zabranu medijskog praćenja, tvrdeći da takve ratne slike zadiru u privatnost obitelji poginulih vojnika. Godine 2005. niz zahtjeva po Zakonu o slobodi informacija (Freedom of Information Act) rezultirao je objavom tih snimaka nakon višemjesečnih pravnih sporova. (Russ Kick, urednik stranice 'The Memory Hole', pokrenuo je te zahtjeve. Kada Pentagon nije odgovorio na moje vlastite zahtjeve, Nacionalni sigurnosni arhiv na Sveučilištu George Washington i ja pokrenuli smo sudsku tužbu.) Nekoliko tjedana prije nego što je savezni sudac trebao donijeti odluku, Pentagon je dobrovoljno objavio više od 700 fotografija povratka žrtava. Te su fotografije i danas javno dostupne na mrežnoj stranici Nacionalnog sigurnosnog arhiva. Dok smo Kick i ja pokušavali objaviti te Pentagonske fotografije, velike američke medijske kuće bile su usredotočene na izvještavanje o invaziji na Irak. Nisu koristile svoje odvjetnike da traže pristup Doveru i to nisu učinile ni kasnije. Politika, koja je prvotno nastala kako bi se izbjegla neugodnost za predsjednika, nakon invazije na Irak pretvorila se u potpunu zabranu koja je Amerikancima onemogućavala da vide ključni pokazatelj troškova rata. Čini se da je Bijela kuća do te mjere pokušavala spriječiti javni uvid u te slike da je vojnim fotografima u Doveru naloženo da potpuno prestanu fotografirati povratke. Koliko mi je poznato, od 2005. više nisu snimljene fotografije tih dirljivih trenutaka kada se žrtva posljednji put vraća na američko tlo. Ukinuće dvadesetogodišnje politike ograničavanja prikaza ratnih žrtava za vrijeme Obamine administracije trebalo bi imati dva neposredna učinka: Prvo, javno mnijenje i dalje snažno podupire objavu tih slika. Prema anketi CNN/Opinion Research Corp. objavljenoj u četvrtak, 67 posto ispitanika smatra da bi javnosti trebalo dopustiti prikaz lijesova američkih vojnika u zračnoj bazi. Drugo, razgovarao sam s brojnim obiteljima koje su izgubile voljene osobe u Afganistanu ili Iraku. Većina ih podržava objavu fotografija, ali tek nakon što obitelji daju dopuštenje. Ova promjena politike ponovno će omogućiti Amerikancima da vide ljudsku cijenu rata, uz odavanje počasti onima koji su služili i njihovim obiteljima. Stajališta navedena u ovom komentaru isključivo su stavovi Ralpha J. Begleitera.

article_content: 91mins: Barry lofts a free-kick into the box, looking for a late Everton equaliser, but Granqvist clears it well. 88mins: Krasnodar are clearly in charge as Gethin Jones comes on for Browning. 85mins: Browning pushes forward before switching the ball to Barry. The move advances to Long on the left side of the area, where his tame effort is easily saved by Sinitsin. 80mins: Garbutt's pass prompts Long to chase a loose ball, and Sigurdsson concedes a free-kick with a reckless tackle. From the set piece, Garbutt picks out Kone's head, but the forward only manages a wild attempt over the bar. 78mins: Chris Long replaces McAleny. 73mins: Laborde, the goal-scorer, makes way for Burmistrov. 72mins: Krasnodar miss a big chance to double their lead: Joaozinho finds himself one-on-one with Robles but opts to pass instead of shooting, and Izmailov's attempt subsequently trickles just wide. 68mins: At one end, Kone stylishly weaves through the Krasnodar defence but loses possession at the last second, while at the other end Izmailov has a long-range shot blocked. 64mins: The 17-year-old Dowell nearly strikes after Oviedo plays him in, but his shot is blocked just as he pulls the trigger, earning a corner. 59mins: Pienaar is booked for a late challenge on Pereyra; Laborde then sends the 30-yard free-kick high over the bar. 54mins: The ball bounces awkwardly to Kone in the box before falling to Oviedo, but the returning full-back fails to connect. Elliott Bretland notes that even though the Krasnodar fans looked absent, there are indeed 14 away supporters in attendance. 49mins: Robles stretches to keep out Laborde's low shot across goal, while Kone hammers an effort at the other end that Sinitsin tips away. 47mins: Everton struggle as Krasnodar continue to dominate possession, but Garbutt wins the ball back and gains a throw. The second half is underway, and though the fixture has little at stake, Roberto Martinez will want his youngsters to shine. At halftime, Krasnodar lead 1-0 after Laborde's goal. 43mins: Kone, who has played well, is shown a yellow card for what appears to be a mild elbow on Kaleshin. Replays suggest it's a harsh decision. 41mins: Garbutt and Pienaar combine nicely on the left, with Garbutt's trickery winning a corner, though Krasnodar clear it. 37mins: McAleny attempts to spark a counter on the right but surrenders possession too easily. The Goodison crowd is subdued as Krasnodar knock the ball around confidently. Elliott Bretland comments that left-back Garbutt appears to have been learning from Leighton Baines with his energetic runs. 30mins: Krasnodar strike first when Laborde bursts through and slips the ball into the near corner beyond Robles. 24mins: Krasnodar enjoy a solid spell of pressure ending with a deflected Laborde shot out for a corner. Dominic King notes the quiet atmosphere but keeps an eye on promising youngsters Dowell and Ledson. 14mins: Kone tries his luck from about 20 yards out, forcing the Krasnodar keeper to parry away. Elliott Bretland remarks on the heavy rain at Goodison Park as Everton's second-string side look to remain unbeaten in Group H. Kone, back after a lengthy injury, is aiming for his first goal in an Everton shirt. 11mins: A hamstring problem forces Atsu off early, handing Dowell his debut. Meanwhile, Krasnodar have brought just 14 fans from southern Russia, with Everton offering them hospitality. Both teams line up with Everton in blue and white, Krasnodar in white and black. Everton had already sealed top spot in Group H after wins over Wolfsburg and Lille. Krasnodar sit bottom, hoping for a first group win to leapfrog Lille. They drew 1-1 in Russia previously. Everton's selection includes Robles, Browning, Alcaraz, Barry, Garbutt, Ledson, Oviedo, McAleny, Pienaar, Atsu, and Kone. Elliott Bretland points out that Martinez is using Barry at center-back with Alcaraz, leaving Browning and Garbutt in their usual full-back roles. Kick-off was at 8:05pm, giving fringe players a chance to impress, as Everton are already through. The match ends 1-0 to Krasnodar courtesy of Laborde's first-half strike, confirmed by Dominic King's post-match report.

Akcija se nastavlja do Longa na lijevoj strani kaznenog prostora, no njegov mlaki udarac Sinitsin lako brani. 80min: Garbutt dodaje loptu Longu, koji juri za njom, a Sigurdsson neoprezno starta i skrivljuje slobodni udarac. Iz prekida Garbutt pronalazi Koneovu glavu, ali napadač šalje loptu daleko poviše gola. 78min: Chris Long zamjenjuje McAlenyja. 73min: Strijelac pogotka Laborde izlazi, a zamjenjuje ga Burmistrov. 72min: Krasnodar propušta veliku priliku za 2-0: Joaozinho izašao sam pred Roblesa, ali je vratio loptu umjesto da puca, a Izmailov ubrzo šalje udarac tik pored vratnice. 68min: Na jednoj strani Kone vješto prolazi kroz obranu Krasnodara, ali gubi loptu u zadnji čas, dok na drugoj strani Izmailov pokušava udarcem iz daljine, ali je blokiran. 64min: Sedamnaestogodišnji Dowell zamalo zabija nakon što ga je Oviedo proigrao u kaznenom prostoru, no udarac mu je blokiran u zadnji tren i izbačen u korner. 59min: Pienaar dobiva žuti karton zbog zakašnjelog starta na Pereyru; Laborde zatim izvodi slobodni udarac s 30 metara visoko preko gola. 54min: Lopta nezgodno dolazi do Konea u šesnaestercu, potom i do Ovieda, ali se povratnik ne uspijeva dobro namjestiti. Elliott Bretland ističe kako se činilo da je tribina gostiju prazna, no zapravo je 14 navijača Krasnodara stiglo na ovu utakmicu bez rezultatske važnosti. 49min: Robles se ispružio i obranio Labordeov niski udarac, dok na drugoj strani Kone snažno puca, a Sinitsin uspijeva odbiti loptu. 47min: Everton se muči, a Krasnodar nastavlja držati posjed, no Garbutt osvaja loptu i izborio je ubacivanje iz auta. Počinje drugo poluvrijeme na Goodison Parku, i iako utakmica ne utječe na poredak, Roberto Martinez želi da se mladi igrači dokažu. Na poluvremenu je 1-0 za Krasnodar, zahvaljujući Labordeovom pogotku. 43min: Kone, koji se istaknuo dobrim igrama, dobiva žuti karton zbog navodnog lakta na Kaleshinu. Ponovljena snimka sugerira da je odluka stroga. 41min: Garbutt i Pienaar dobro surađuju na lijevoj strani, a Garbuttova vještina donosi korner Evertonu, iako Krasnodar to čisti. 37min: McAleny pokušava povući kontru s desna, no prerano gubi loptu u sredini. Goodison Park je prilično tih, dok Krasnodar samouvjereno dodaje loptu. Elliott Bretland komentira da je Garbutt vjerojatno učio od Leightona Bainesa, sudeći po energičnim prodorima prema naprijed. 30min: Krasnodar dolazi u vodstvo kad se Laborde probija i šalje loptu u bliži kut pokraj Roblesa. 24min: Gosti su stvorili pritisak, završivši s Labordeovim udarcem koji se odbio u korner. Dominic King napominje da je atmosfera tiha, ali prati mlade nade Dowella i Ledsona. 14min: Kone silovito šutira s dvadesetak metara i tjera vratara Krasnodara na obranu. Elliott Bretland primjećuje da kiša snažno pada na Goodison Parku, dok rezervna momčad Evertona želi ostati neporažena u skupini H. Kone, vraćen nakon duge ozljede, traži svoj prvi pogodak za Everton. 11min: Atsu zbog ozljede mišića mora napustiti teren, a Dowell ulazi za svoj debi. Krasnodar je doputovao s 14 navijača iz južne Rusije, a Everton im je ukazao gostoprimstvo. Momčadi izlaze na travnjak, Everton u plavim dresovima i bijelim hlačicama, a gosti u bijelim dresovima i crnim hlačicama. Everton je već osigurao vrh skupine H nakon pobjeda nad Wolfsburgom i Lilleom. Krasnodar je na dnu i nada se prvoj pobjedi u skupini kako bi možda prestigao Lille. Prethodno su u Rusiji odigrali 1-1. Evertonov sastav uključuje Roblesa, Browninga, Alcaraza, Barryja, Garbutta, Ledsona, Ovieda, McAlenyja, Pienaara, Atsua i Konea. Elliott Bretland dodaje da Martinez koristi Barryja kao stopera uz Alcaraza, ostavljajući Browninga i Garbutta na bekovskim pozicijama. Utakmica je počela u 20:05, pružajući priliku igračima s klupe i mladima, budući da je Everton već osigurao prolaz. Susret završava 1-0 za Krasnodar zahvaljujući Labordeovom pogotku iz prvog dijela. Dominic King potvrđuje da su gosti odnijeli sva tri boda.

article_content: This set of images depicts an annular solar eclipse, as captured on February 26, 2017, at the Estancia El Muster near Sarmiento in Argentinas Chubut province, 1600 kilometers south of Buenos Aires. On that Sunday, eager onlookers cheered as the moon briefly blocked the sun, revealing a dazzling ring-of-fire effect. / AFP / ALEJANDRO PAGNI (Photo credit should be attributed to ALEJANDRO PAGNI/AFP via Getty Images). When is the next solar eclipse? On Saturday, October 14, 2023, there will be a special chance across North America to glimpse a partial solar eclipse, with 32 million Americans able to witness a ring of fire for a short interval. Eclipse enthusiasts worldwide will head to Oregon, California, Nevada, Idaho, Utah, Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico, and Texas to observe the peak of this annular eclipse, though areas outside the 125-mile-wide path will see only a partial view. Here are 10 things to know about this rare celestial event in the United States and beyond: 1. It Will Be Visible From Both Hemispheres: Anyone located in North, Central, and South America can witness part of Saturdays eclipse, though the ring of light will only be visible in the narrow path crossing the Pacific, several countries including the United States, Mexico, and others in Central and South America, before ending at sunset in the Atlantic. 2. Solar Protection Is Essential: This eclipse must be viewed with approved solar filters to protect your eyes, cameras, and telescopes. Local retailers, museums, and libraries can supply solar eclipse glasses. 3. Its Caused By A Small New Moon: Because the moon is farther from Earth, it cannot obscure the sun fully, leading to a ring instead of total darkness. Approximately 91 percent of the suns disk will be covered, making it a striking partial eclipse. 4. It Will Hang Over Two Eclipse Petroglyphs: Near Winnemucca in Nevada, along the centerline, lies Water Canyon with an ancient petroglyph thought to show an eclipse. In New Mexicos Chaco Canyon, a rock carving may represent a total eclipse from roughly one thousand years ago. 5. Nobody Will See The Ring Of Fire In Idaho: Although Idaho barely falls within the path, just 43 square miles near Oregon and Nevada will experience about 1 minute 27 seconds of ring visibility. 6. It Is The First Ring Of Fire In The United States Since 2012: Although 2021 had an annular eclipse over North America, the ring was seen only in Canada. The last time the southwestern US got a ring-of-fire was on May 20, 2012. 7. A Grazing Zone Will Sweep Across Utahs Canyonlands National Park: If you stand exactly on the centerline, the ring lasts over four minutes. Moving toward the edge leads to only a brief view of the ring, sometimes broken. Bailys beads last longer near that edge. 8. It Will Be Seen Above A Mayan Temple: Part of Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula will show the ring directly over the Edzna archaeological site at about 11:23 a.m., lasting 4 minutes and 32 seconds. 9. It Will Be The Last American Ring Of Fire Until 2039: The next annular eclipse is October 2, 2024, visible from Easter Island and parts of Chile and Argentina. The US will not see another ring-of-fire until 2039 in Alaska, and that region will manifest another in 2046. 10. This Eclipse Has Echoes In 2005 and 2041: Eclipses often follow an 18-year, 11-day cycle called a saros. This is part of Saros 134, linking it to the ring-of-fire eclipses of October 3, 2005, and October 25, 2041. (Corrected spelling of which.) The author is an eclipse specialist, editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com, and writer of The Complete Guide To The Great North American Eclipse of April 8, 2024. For fresh updates on the ring-of-fire eclipse, check daily articles. Wishing clear skies and wide eyes.

Tog su dana promatraci s uzbudenjem gledali kako Mjesec nakratko blokira Sunce, otkrivajuci zadivljujuci vatreni prsten. / AFP / ALEJANDRO PAGNI (Foto zasluge: ALEJANDRO PAGNI/AFP preko Getty Images). Kada je sljedeca pomrcina Sunca? U subotu, 14. listopada 2023., na podrucju cijele Sjeverne Amerike pruzit ce se jedinstvena prilika za promatranje djelomicne pomrcine Sunca, a 32 milijuna Amerikanaca moci ce nakratko vidjeti vatreni prsten. Zaljubljenici u pomrcine iz cijelog svijeta otputovat ce u Oregan, Kaliforniju, Nevadu, Idaho, Utah, Arizonu, Colorado, Novi Meksiko i Teksas kako bi promatrali vrhunac ove prstenaste pomrcine, iako ce podrucja izvan 125 milja sirine vidjeti samo djelomicnu verziju. Evo deset vaznih cinjenica o ovom rijetkom nebeskom dogadaju u Sjedinjenim Drzavama i sire: 1. Bit ce vidljiva s obje hemisfere: Bilo tko u Sjevernoj, Srednjoj i Juznoj Americi moci ce promatrati dio subotnje pomrcine, iako ce vatreni prsten biti vidljiv samo u uskom pojasu koji prolazi preko Pacifika, nekoliko zemalja ukljucujuci SAD, Meksiko i druge u Srednjoj i Juznoj Americi, prije nego sto zavrsi pri zalasku sunca u Atlantiku. 2. Zastita za Sunce je neophodna: Pomrcinu se mora promatrati koristeci odobrene solarne filtre za zastitu ociju, fotoaparata i teleskopa. Lokalni trgovci, muzeji i knjiznice mogu ponuditi naocale za pomrcinu Sunca. 3. Nastaje zbog malenog mladog Mjeseca: Buduci da je Mjesec udaljeniji od Zemlje, ne moze potpuno zakloniti Sunce, sto dovodi do prstena umjesto potpune tame. Otprilike 91 posto Sunceve povrsine bit ce pokriveno, stvarajuci upadljivu djelomicnu pomrcinu. 4. Nad dva petroglifa koji prikazuju pomrcinu: U blizini Winnemuccae u Nevadi, uz sredisnju liniju, nalazi se Water Canyon s drevnim petroglifom za koji se vjeruje da prikazuje pomrcinu. U kanjonu Chaco u Novom Meksiku, na stijenama se nalazi urez koji bi mogao predstavljati potpunu pomrcinu od prije otprilike tisucu godina. 5. Ring of Fire nece biti vidljiv u Idahu: Premda se Idaho jedva nalazi unutar putanje, samo 43 kvadratne milje blizu Oregona i Nevade dozivjet ce oko minutu i 27 sekundi prstena. 6. Ovo je prvi Ring of Fire u SAD-u od 2012.: Iako je 2021. zabiljezena prstenasta pomrcina Sunca nad Sjevernom Amerikom, prsten je bio vidljiv samo u Kanadi. Posljednji put kada je jugozapadni dio SAD-a dozivio ovaj efekt bio je 20. svibnja 2012. 7. Podrucje uz rub prolazi preko Nacionalnog parka Canyonlands u Utahu: Ako se nalazite tocno na srednjoj liniji, prsten traje vise od cetiri minute. Pomak prema rubu daje samo kratak pogled na prsten, ponekad prekinut, a Bailyeve perle traju duze u tom podrucju. 8. Vidjet ce se iznad drevnog majanskog hrama: Dio poluotoka Yucatan u Meksiku prikazat ce prsten neposredno iznad arheoloskog podrucja Edzna oko 11:23 sati, uz trajanje od otprilike 4 minute i 32 sekunde. 9. Ovo ce biti posljednji Ring of Fire u Americi do 2039.: Sljedeca prstenasta pomrcina bit ce 2. listopada 2024., vidljiva s Uskrsnjeg otoka i dijelova Cilea i Argentine. SAD nece ponovno vidjeti vatreni prsten do 2039. u Aljasci, a taj ce se fenomen u slicnom podrucju ponoviti 2046. 10. Ova pomrcina povezana je s 2005. i 2041. godinom: Pomrcine obicno slijede 18-godisnji i 11-dnevni ciklus, poznat kao saros. Ova pripada sarosu 134, povezujuci je s prstenastim pomrcinama 3. listopada 2005. i 25. listopada 2041. (ispravljena pravopisna pogreska which). article_content: Late on Sunday, suspected Boko Haram fighters entered the Kawuri village market in Nigeria’s Borno state, killing at least 45 people and wounding 26, according to the police commissioner. The attackers arrived in vehicles with four-wheel drive and fired on people as they finished their day at the market, then set fire to thatched houses, reported Borno police commissioner Lawan Tanko. Isa Ibrahim, a merchant who witnessed the attack, explained that the assailants initially acted like regular customers. He suspected that bombs, possibly planted in advance, were used. Although the police bomb squad searched for any unexploded devices, Tanko said it was not confirmed if explosives were part of the assault. Boko Haram, an Islamist militia, has repeatedly assaulted northeastern Nigeria in an effort to impose strict Sharia law. Borno has been under a state of emergency since May due to ongoing violence.

Napadači su stigli u vozilima s pogonom na sva četiri kotača i otvorili vatru na ljude dok su završavali dan na tržnici, a zatim zapalili kuće s krovovima od slame, izvijestio je policijski povjerenik države Borno, Lawan Tanko. Isa Ibrahim, trgovac koji je svjedočio napadu, objasnio je da su se napadači u početku ponašali kao obični kupci. Posumnjao je da su korištene bombe, možda postavljene unaprijed. Iako je policijski tim za bombe pretraživao područje u potrazi za neeksplodiranim napravama, Tanko je rekao da još nije potvrđeno jesu li eksplozivi korišteni. Boko Haram, islamistička militantna skupina, više je puta napadala sjeveroistok Nigerije s ciljem nametanja stroge verzije šerijatskog zakona. Borno je od svibnja pod izvanrednim stanjem zbog kontinuiranog nasilja.
